dataset.classification: Hybrid research dataset: original SUKELCO Tacurong annual consumption/customer anchors with derived daily allocation; other municipality-day records remain research-grade synthetic.

model_architecture.mlr: One pooled MLR with municipality and other categories one-hot encoded.
model_architecture.sarima: One direct daily SARIMA per municipality/city.
model_architecture.hybrid: Pooled MLR plus a municipality-specific residual SARIMA correction.

scientific_warnings: Tacurong City annual consumption totals for 2020-2024 are anchored exactly to the original SUKELCO History Ledger supplied by the researcher; the daily Tacurong profile remains a derived allocation because the ledger is annual/route-aggregate rather than daily.
Other municipality-day electricity records, weather fields, capacity fields, outage fields, and recommendation reference labels remain research-grade synthetic or modeled unless otherwise documented.
Recommendation reference labels remain synthetic deterministic rules and require electric-utility expert validation.
Test metrics represent rolling one-day-ahead operation, not an unobserved ten-year recursive forecast.

original_data_integration.source: SUKELCO Tacurong City History Ledger supplied by the researcher
original_data_integration.method: For Tacurong City, the pre-existing daily intra-year profile was scaled so annual kWh equals each original SUKELCO History Ledger total exactly. Annual Grand Total Consumers / 12 was used as the annual-average consumer-entry anchor. Daily weather and non-Tacurong municipality records remain research/model-derived because the supplied files do not contain daily observations for those fields.
